mission.text: To revolutionize customer support through intelligent, human-centric AI solutions that drive satisfaction, reduce costs, and scale with ease.

vision.text: A world where every customer interaction is fast, helpful, and personalized — powered by ethical AI.

whatWeDo.text: CallFairy builds AI-powered tools for modern customer support teams — including virtual agents, voice bots, and predictive analytics — to deliver faster resolutions and exceptional customer experiences.

team.name: Prathmesh Churhe
team.title: Co-founder & Sr. AI Engineer
team.bio: Prathmesh leads CallFairy with a vision to make AI accessible and human-first. With over a decade in machine learning and enterprise software, he is passionate about ethical AI and customer-first design.

team.name: Parikshit Jadhav
team.title: Co-founder & Sr. Project Manager
team.bio: Parikshit oversees daily operations and customer success initiatives. Her background in operations and strategic planning ensures that CallFairy scales smoothly and delivers on its promises.

team.name: Siddhant Pawar
team.title: Co-founder & lead Developer
team.bio: Siddhant brings over 3 years of experience in CX strategy, helping companies implement service frameworks that foster long-term loyalty.
